meta.note: The 2026 CrossFit Games will score 20 events across 4 days (July 22-26), the most in Games history. Individuals open at off-site Bay Area locations on Wednesday, July 22 before three arena days at SAP Center. CrossFit reveals the official numbered events closer to and during the competition. This tracker follows every confirmed, revealed and teased element as it drops, with the source.

items.name: The Hopper Draw
items.summary: DRAWN at Opening Ceremonies on Friday morning: the original 2007 hopper drum produced SNATCH and TOES-TO-BAR as the two movements for the Friday night closer (expected Event 12; official number pending). The final workout structure is being decided by a vote before the session - loads, reps and format unknown until it closes. The only prior Games event combining the two: the 2024 Dickies Triplet, won by Jayson Hopper, who is in this field. We publish the full workout the moment it is official.

items.name: Event 18: Machine 7200M
items.summary: Published on the official workouts page: for time, row 3,600 meters then ski 3,600 meters, under a 30-minute time cap for men / 35-minute cap for women. Presented by Saatva. Scheduled for Sunday, July 26. A pure double-machine test with no exact Games precedent (closest matches: the 2020 Stage 1 1,000m Row and the 2022 Rinse 'N' Repeat swim/SkiErg interval).

items.name: Event 19: Roll to Support AMRAP
items.summary: The official workouts page has published the full scored prescription for the ring skills Dave Castro teased in July: a 5-minute AMRAP of 4 forward rolls to support and 3 backward rolls to support. Presented by Velites. Scheduled for Sunday, July 26. Both movements have zero precedent in Games history (2007-2025).

items.name: Event 6: Grass Oval Bicycle Race
items.summary: Confirmed as Individual Event 6 on the official CrossFit Games Instagram (July 20): a Grass Oval Bicycle Race, 20 laps for time under a 25-minute cap, on Wednesday July 22 at the Morgan Hill Outdoor Complex. The outdoor bike race returns (last run as the 2023 "Ride"). Per-lap distance and bike type are not yet announced.

items.name: Event 8: Climbing Snail '26
items.summary: Published on the official workouts page for Friday, July 24: for time under a 10-minute cap - a 400-lb Snail push (100 feet men / 60 feet women), legless rope climbs (3 men / 2 women), 30 toes-to-bars, rope climbs (5 men / 4 women), and a closing Snail push - all wearing a weight vest (22 lb men / 16 lb women). A rerun-in-spirit of the 2016 Climbing Snail (berm run, rope ascents, Snail pushes), won that year by Brent Fikowski and Samantha Briggs.

items.name: Event 10: Run Hang Squat Clean
items.summary: Published on the official workouts page for Friday, July 24: 4 rounds for time of a 660-meter run and 10 hang squat cleans on a short barbell (225 lb men / 155 lb women). No exact Games precedent for a run plus hang-squat-clean interval; the closest recent cousin is the 2025 Albany Grip Trip (runs, axle deadlifts and handstand walks), won by Jay Crouch and Lucy Campbell.

items.name: Event 11: Handstand Sprint
items.summary: Published on the official workouts page for Friday, July 24: for time, a handstand walk course under a 6-minute cap. The name is a direct callback to the 2020 Handstand Sprint (a 100-yard handstand walk at the Ranch, won by Mat Fraser and Brooke Wells). Handstand-walk events are a Games staple with deep history in this field: Danielle Brandon has won three handstand-walk-family events (2021, 2022, 2023), Nick Mathew won the 2022 Skill Speed Medley, and Jay Crouch and Lucy Campbell won the handstand-walk-heavy 2025 Albany Grip Trip. Course layout and the event number are not yet announced.

items.name: Event 9: 3D Throw
items.summary: Published on the official workouts page for Friday, July 24: for total distance, one throw to the right, one throw to the left, and one throw backward, with a 30 lb implement for men and 20 lb for women. Presented by Rogue. Throwing for distance has not been tested at the Games since 2012 (the GHD Ball Toss - itself a backward toss for distance - and the 2011 softball throw before it), and those used far lighter implements. The implement type and the individual event number are not yet announced.

items.name: Event 7: Swim Standard
items.summary: Published on the official workouts page as the Day 1 closer: for time, a descending swim-and-burpee ladder - 200m swim, 40 burpees, 150m swim, 30 burpees, 100m swim, 20 burpees, 50m swim, 10 burpees - under a 15-minute cap. That is 500 meters of pool swimming (25-meter lengths, presented by TYR) broken by 100 total burpees. The first Games swim event since the 2022 Rinse 'N' Repeat pool intervals, and a FloElite-exclusive broadcast. Individual Event 7 on Wednesday, July 22 at the Morgan Hill Outdoor Sport Center.

items.name: Event 15: Speed Snatch Triple
items.summary: Published on the official workouts page July 17: three sets of 3 ascending snatches under 1, 2 and 3-minute caps, topping at 285 lb (men) / 185 lb (women). A rerun of the 2020 Games event of the same name (won by Fraser and Toomey), which itself echoed the 2015 Snatch Speed Ladder. Confirmed as Individual Event 15.

items.name: Event 13: The 500-Meter Sprint
items.summary: Individual Event 13 is a 500-meter sprint, published on the official Games workouts page July 16. Roughly a minute and a half of maximal running for this field: the deepest glycolytic test on the weekend. Venue and heat format not yet announced.

items.name: Event 1: The 2007 Hopper
items.summary: The opener revives the inaugural 2007 Games event: a 1,000-meter row, then 5 rounds of 25 pull-ups and 7 push jerks (135 lb men / 85 lb women), for time. Event 1 of the individual competition on Wednesday, July 22.

items.name: Event 2: Ranch 7200
items.summary: Event 2 sends the field off-road: a 7,200-meter trail run at the Aromas ranch, for time. About 4.5 miles of dirt on the opening day (Wednesday, July 22) at the off-site venues, a relentless endurance test presented by Air National Guard.

items.name: Event 3: The CrossFit Total - Back Squat
items.summary: The first lift of The CrossFit Total: a 1-rep-max back squat, scored as its own event worth 50 points. The Total (back squat, shoulder press, deadlift) runs on the opening day, Wednesday, July 22.

items.name: Event 4: The CrossFit Total - Shoulder Press
items.summary: The second lift of The CrossFit Total: a 1-rep-max strict shoulder press, scored as its own event worth 50 points. The Total (back squat, shoulder press, deadlift) runs on the opening day, Wednesday, July 22.

items.name: Event 5: The CrossFit Total - Deadlift
items.summary: The third lift of The CrossFit Total: a 1-rep-max deadlift, scored as its own event worth 50 points. The Total (back squat, shoulder press, deadlift) runs on the opening day, Wednesday, July 22.

items.name: Pool swim confirmed at 25-meter lengths
items.summary: CrossFit confirmed the returning swim will be contested in 25-meter pool lengths, a further specific on the pool (not open water) swim event presented by TYR.

items.name: Swimming held in a pool (not ocean), TYR-presented, at Morgan Hill
items.summary: CrossFit confirmed the returning swim event will be held in a pool rather than open water, presented by TYR Sport as Official Swim Partner, most likely Wednesday at the Morgan Hill Outdoor Sport Center (the 2020 Games swim venue). This is a specific upgrade to the bare 'swimming returns' fact.

items.name: Individual competition opens with off-site events July 22 across the Bay Area
items.summary: CrossFit confirmed individual athletes begin on Wednesday, July 22 at multiple off-site Bay Area locations (not open to the general public but livestreamed; select sites open to Rx+ Experience holders), making it a four-day individual competition ahead of the SAP Center arena days.

items.name: Big Bob sled drag race
items.summary: In the 'Making of the 2026 Games' SAP Center walkthrough, Dave Castro floated bringing back the Big Bob sled, musing about a team drag race 'sprinting Big Bob down Barack Obama' Boulevard, calling it 'epic.' Explicitly a hint, possibly misdirection.

items.name: Outdoor running on Barack Obama Boulevard / ~400-yard loop
items.summary: During the SAP walkthrough Castro used a trundle wheel to measure from the arena floor out onto the street and noted a turnaround ~200 yards down Barack Obama Boulevard, hinting at an outdoor run / roughly 400-yard looped course using closed public roads (Sharks Way / Barack Obama Blvd).

items.name: Extra competition day at The Ranch (Aromas), non-spectator
items.summary: Castro hinted the 2026 Games may run more than the three SAP Center days, with additional non-spectator competition potentially at The Ranch in Aromas, CA: 'The Games might be three days... they also might be more than three days,' with extra days not available for spectators.

items.name: Possible previously-unprogrammed movement in 2026 ('Possibly')
items.summary: Asked whether the 2026 Open/Games would feature a new movement, Castro said he doesn't believe truly 'new' movements exist but, on whether a previously-unprogrammed movement could appear, answered 'Possibly' (and joked cornrows would not return). A deliberate non-commitment.

items.name: Behind the Scenes: event testing at The Ranch with Rafael Sancen
items.summary: CrossFit's 'Behind the Scenes: Programming the 2026 CrossFit Games' video series shows Castro testing candidate 2026 events at The Ranch with athlete Rafael Sancen in the weeks before the Games, confirming active event prototyping though specific movements aren't itemized.

items.name: Rogue Pig and Snail descriptions
items.summary: The returning implements are described by CrossFit/Wikipedia as the 'Pig' (a heavy block encased in rubber) and the 'Snail' (an object shaped like a bale of hay but partly filled with sand that shifts as it's rolled), giving the concrete form of the confirmed 2026 equipment.

items.name: Individuals compete across 4 days: July 22 (Wed) through July 26 (Sun)
items.summary: The Individual division begins competition Wednesday, July 22, and finishes Sunday, July 26 - a four-day competition window. Teams begin a day later, Thursday, July 23, and also finish July 26.

items.name: Individual Games open at multiple Bay Area off-site locations (July 22)
items.summary: The first Individual events on July 22 take place at multiple off-site locations across the Bay Area, not at SAP Center. These off-sites are not open to the general public but are livestreamed; select off-sites are open to Rx+ Experience holders.

source.label: CrossFit Games (official) - 2026 Games to Kick Off on July 22 with Multiple Off-Sites

items.name: Second San Jose venue: McEnery Convention Center for Masters/Teenage/Adaptive
items.summary: Beyond SAP Center, the San Jose McEnery Convention Center serves as a secondary 2026 Games venue, hosting the Masters, Teenage, and Adaptive divisions during the same competition window.

items.name: Tickets cover only 3 days at SAP Center (July 24-26), not the full 4-day field schedule
items.summary: SAP Center hosts events Friday, July 24 through Sunday, July 26. The Arena Ticket Package is a three-day ticket (July 24-26) granting a reserved seat for all events held inside SAP Center; the earlier off-site days are not part of the arena ticket.

source.label: CrossFit Games (official) - 2026 Games to Kick Off on July 22 with Multiple Off-Sites

items.name: Arena Ticket Package sold via Sharks/SAP Center ticketing, on sale March 24, 2026
items.summary: Tickets to the 2026 CrossFit Games arena events are purchased through the San Jose Sharks + SAP Center ticketing page (Ticketmaster), with single and multi-day options. The three-day Arena Ticket Package went on sale March 24, 2026.
